bio: Sommelier in Tuscany. Vineyards at dawn, cellar candlelight and the patient science of a good glass.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her late 30s with wavy chestnut hair holding a wine glass in a stone cellar, candlelight, warm smile, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of rolling Tuscan vineyards with cypress trees in golden morning mist, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: From vine to glass
collections.description: A year in Tuscany, in four scenes.

videos.title: Harvest morning in the vines
videos.description: Pickers' hands, ripe grapes and a golden mist over the rows.
videos.still: Wide photograph of vineyard rows in golden morning mist during harvest with crates of grapes and pickers far away seen from behind, Tuscany, no text
videos.motion: Mist drifts between the vine rows and sunlight breaks through, pickers move slowly in the distance, gentle push-in.

videos.title: Swirl, sniff, taste
videos.description: A glass of red catching the light.
videos.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a hand swirling a glass of deep red wine against warm candlelight, shallow depth of field, no face, no text
videos.motion: The wine swirls slowly in the glass and the candle light shimmers, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: The cellar, candlelit
videos.description: Barrels, cool stone and a lantern.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a stone wine cellar with rows of oak barrels lit by a single lantern, a faint haze in the air, no people, no text
videos.motion: Lantern light flickers and haze drifts between the barrels, slow push-in down the aisle.

videos.title: Cypress road at sunset
videos.description: The long road between the hills as the day closes.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a Tuscan gravel road lined with cypress trees at sunset over rolling hills, golden light, no people, no text
videos.motion: Golden light slowly deepens and the cypress branches sway softly, slow camera rise.

stories.caption: Grapes still cold
stories.still: Vertical photograph of a bunch of dark grapes with dew in a wooden crate, morning light, no text

stories.caption: Cork pull
stories.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a corkscrew pulling a cork from a wine bottle, warm light, no face, no text

stories.caption: Terrace lunch
stories.still: Vertical photograph of a stone terrace table with bread, olive oil and two glasses of wine overlooking hills, no people, no text
